description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen the capacities of its Member States to advance disability inclusion in sport and physical education, fostering social inclusion, equality, and human development. The biennium 2026–2027 represents an exceptional window, marked by the 2027 Special Olympics World Summer Games in Santiago, the LA 2028 Paralympic Games, that can both build on the Santiago Roadmap – Future in Play (November 2025), and the UNESCO–AmPC MoU. The office will operationalize the UNESCO–AmPC MoU and the Special Olympics Latin America partnership through joint capacity-building for coaches, teachers, and sport administrators; support covers countries to engage with the Fit for Life Sport Alliance and implement youth-led inclusive sport initiatives; and facilitate countries' participation in the MINEPS VIII preparatory process to ensure the region's perspectives shape the international sport policy agenda.
